prompt: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching, like a page from a Renaissance master's sketchbook. A gruesome corpse whose head is a half-rotted skull, with patches of rotting flesh still clinging to it and thin, wispy, rotting hair hanging from it, crowned with a wreath of field flowers. Her lower jaw is detached and hangs loose by a strip of sinew below her upper teeth, and a long, gruesome tongue hangs out and down over her chest. Her eyes are solid white and rotted, in deep sockets. She is fully clothed, covered from neck to ankle in a rotting, tattered, long-sleeved peasant dress, and her bony, withered hands hold a curved sickle. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper. silverpoint study, metalpoint drawing, Renaissance sketch, hatching and cross-hatching, fine line, high contrast, sharp focus, monochrome, clean light paper ground
